findings.location: <div class="poem"> stanza 2 (lines: "One working band, one harvest-song, one King omnipotent.")
findings.source_quote: One working band, one harvest-song, one King omnipotent.
findings.suggested_fix: Render "one working band" as a group (band) rather than as a noun meaning "work"; remove the added phrase "en unión." A faithful rendering could be: "Una sola agrupación laboriosa, un mismo canto de siega, un Rey omnipotente." or "Una banda laboriosa, un canto de siega, un Rey omnipotente." Preserve the triplet rhythm and parallelism.
findings.translation_quote: una sola labor, un mismo canto de siega, un Rey omnipotente en unión.

findings.location: <div class="poem"> stanza 1 (line: "The true thy chartered freemen are / of every age and clime:")
findings.source_quote:
The true thy chartered freemen are
of every age and clime:
findings.suggested_fix: Correct number agreement and use idiomatic Spanish for "age and clime." For example: "Los verdaderos, tus libertos manumitidos son / de toda edad y clima:" or more smoothly: "Tus verdaderos liberados son de toda edad y clima:" or "Tus verdaderos ciudadanos son de toda edad y clima:" Keep the idea of enfranchised/members ("chartered freemen") and preserve plural agreement.
findings.translation_quote:
Tus verdaderos ciudadanos son
de toda era y climas:
